nominal_interline.exclusions: Pairs sharing a declared junction are intentional; internal module circuits and fitting envelopes are not qualified.

flex_structure.basis: Retained locomotive structure only. Moving boxes conservatively expanded +/-50 mm in truck-local Z, then posed with declared route heave. New fittings/brackets, skin and service-tool clearances remain outside this screen.

limits: Reference LT33 loads have not been recalculated for new routing weights. Prescribed probes are geometric envelopes, not equilibrium or coupled train dynamics.
Polyline interline checks are sampled; no continuous hose mechanics, twist, pressure growth, dynamic whipping or fatigue approval.
Static AABBs are conservative; negative gaps are review holds, not accepted routes. Skin penetrations, tools, heat and local support strength remain open.
Coach C57 body-to-truck hoses retain earlier separate checks; only added fixed tails follow the coach body in this revision. Full-consist brake sizing and C57 port mapping remain incomplete.
